description: C01 mechanism controls, EXPLORATORY: added after the confirmatory Part II result (the clock explains most of the LSTM's advantage). Two arms that know the time but have no memory: LSTM-reset with the clock fed to its cell (11,495 parameters) and the small MLP with the clock fed to its encoder (2,951). Same first 10 seeds as C01-PARTE2-FASE1, learning rate 0.001 (the protocol's), 300k interactions, re-evaluated 3 times; then the validation-selected checkpoint is played on the C01 sealed panel under its own evaluation id.
